text: {"lessons":["Selling Stock A and Stock E after gains felt rewarding, but I should let the investment outlook—not the satisfaction of locking in a profit—guide when I sell.","After selling Stock A, I bought it again at a different price; I should assess each new trade on its merits and avoid anchoring on past sale prices or average cost.","I held through both declines and rebounds, so I should keep reviewing the whole portfolio and follow consistent risk-based rules rather than react to short-term account changes."]}
